integrity: The mathematical proof derives all-height assertions; finite rank calculations and exhaustive small-state tests provide independent computational corroboration, not an infinite certificate. No external independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The divisibility hypothesis is sufficient for arbitrary irregular rooted trees, with necessity shown only for homogeneous complete d-ary trees. Earlier first-extinction shells and all Jordan block multiplicities are not classified. Possible unindexed equivalent literature remains an originality risk.
title: Sharp extinction and universal terminal shells in characteristic-divisible rooted-tree dynamics
